data.label: MEASURED
data.definition: Share of checked answers (666 checked, as recorded in cap350.json quality.checked) whose output passes every fixed check for its prompt; a missing output counts as a fail (src/wattnot/gates/fixed.py).
data.gate: Capped pass rate must be at least the uncapped (700 W) pass rate minus 1.0 percentage point (max_drop_pts = 1.0).
data.not_this_metric: The 95% figure elsewhere in WattNot is a different gate: token or answer agreement with the unchanged setup, used for adaptive top-k and model routing only. It does not apply to power caps.
